cards.title: A steady opening
cards.description: Brace protects in place against a bolt. Walking during a pulse changes position. This is a starting proposal, not a supplied Plate rig or a promise of survival.

cards.title: Draw a path
cards.description: Draw advances one cell against a bolt while spending three resolve. Move during a pulse. A Trail rig is suggested here, not acquired or equipped by this card.

cards.title: Brace, then move
cards.description: Keep Brace and add earned Dash as a separate action. Dash spends one resolve to move two cells. This amendment requires actual level two; it grants no points or recovery.

cards.title: Draw, then range
cards.description: Keep Draw and add earned Dash for a different movement choice. Both spend actual resolve. This amendment requires actual level two and does not refill resources or begin the next encounter.
